task_instance: In a small existing Quarkus 3.40.1 (Java 21, Maven) project, implement the skill's primary deliverable: add a JSON REST feature - a GreetingResource with Bean Validation (@NotBlank/@Size), a @ServerExceptionMapper returning 404, @ConfigMapping-based typed config, OpenAPI metadata, and a @QuarkusTest per the rest.md pattern - then verify it per the skill's agent rules.
blocker_detail: The skill's core workflow requires executing code/build tooling that this office-assistant runtime does not provide. Agent rule 2 requires adding extensions through the Quarkus CLI or the Maven wrapper (never hand-editing artifact ids/versions), and agent rule 5 requires verifying with dev mode and the Maven verify goal and running a @QuarkusTest, stating 'Do not claim something works without running it.' Verifying the feature means compiling the project, resolving the platform BOM, and running RestAssured tests against a live Quarkus HTTP server. This runtime cannot run any shell command, Maven/Quarkus build, or JVM, so the extensions cannot be installed via the CLI and the deliverable cannot be compiled, started, or tested. The Java source was authored as text but its correctness (compilation, 200/400/404 behavior, OpenAPI path) cannot be confirmed without a build, which the skill treats as mandatory.
evidence: Read SKILL.md and references/rest.md (plus listed references/ config-cdi, persistence, reactive-messaging, security-oidc, observability-resilience present next to SKILL.md). Created a sample existing Quarkus project and the feature code under the work directory: sample-quarkus-app/pom.xml (quarkus.platform.version 3.40.1, Java 21, BOM-managed quarkus-rest-jackson + quarkus-hibernate-validator + quarkus-smallrye-openapi), src/main/java/org/acme/greeting/GreetingConfig.java (@ConfigMapping), src/main/java/org/acme/greeting/GreetingResource.java (POST/GET + @ServerExceptionMapper), src/main/resources/application.properties, src/test/java/org/acme/greeting/GreetingResourceTest.java (@QuarkusTest, 4 RestAssured cases). Verification step blocked: the runtime has no shell/JVM/Maven, so `./mvnw quarkus:add-extension`, `./mvnw quarkus:dev` + /q/dev-ui, and `./mvnw verify` cannot be executed; the code therefore could not be compiled or tested and the skill forbids claiming it works unrun.
